# Session 4 - What the Tide Left

## Deeper In

The marsh opened out into standing water and the poles stopped finding bottom.

## The Cinder Steps

A stair of burnt stone rising out of the water with nothing at the top of it.
[[Cinder Steps]] is on no chart the crew carried.

## Sister Ilva

[[Sister Ilva]] was already there, and had been for some time. She asked no questions
about why the crew had come, which unsettled Petra more than questions would have.

## The Astrolabe

[[The Brass Astrolabe]] was at the top of the steps, in the open, dry.

## Old Bellwether

On the way out they met [[Old Bellwether]], who claimed to have surveyed this route for
the Company forty years ago and to have been paid never to mention it.

## Session Summary

### Major Events

- [[The Brass Astrolabe]] recovered, closing [[Errand - Recover the Brass Astrolabe]].
- [[Cinder Steps]] found, and it is on no chart.
- [[Old Bellwether]] contradicts the Company's account of the survey.

### Loot & Rewards

- [[The Brass Astrolabe]].
- Nothing else; the steps were bare.

### Character Moments

- Odo went back for the lantern and would not say why.

### New Faces

- [[Sister Ilva]]
- [[Old Bellwether]]

### Political Developments

- The Company's forty-year silence is now a thread the crew can pull.

### Open Threads

- What the astrolabe is for.
- Why [[Sister Ilva]] was waiting.
- Whether [[The Ninth Lock]] exists at all.

### Party Status

- Level 3. Lantern oil low. One pole lost.
